description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Real-time global earthquake events from USGS. Filter by magnitude, depth, location radius, or time window. Returns location, magnitude, depth, PAGER alert, and USGS event URL. Free primary source — no API key.
